text: My name is Venkateswara Reddy Pochana. I am based in Jena, Germany. My professional background spans data engineering, data science, business intelligence, automation, cloud platforms, and an earlier foundation in mechanical and production engineering.

At Dow Silicones Deutschland GmbH, I worked as a Master's Thesis Researcher in Data Science from May 2024 to July 2025. I led statistical analysis of polymer manufacturing data across more than 10 process checkpoints, identifying process parameters with over 70% correlation to product quality and optimizing operating conditions through targeted experiments.

At Dow Silicones Deutschland GmbH, I developed and validated machine-learning models using historical polymer production data to predict final product properties, achieving 85% prediction accuracy and reducing quality drift by 50%. I also owned experimental data standardization across EMEA research teams, established consistent data workflows, and drove adoption through workshops and hands-on training, reducing manual data preparation by 20%.

At Carl Zeiss AG, I worked as a Data Engineer Intern from December 2023 to April 2024. I designed and deployed an automated document-processing pipeline using Python, NLP-based entity extraction, regular expressions, and PDF processing for more than 10,000 invoices per month, reducing manual effort by 70%.

At Carl Zeiss AG, I developed Azure Data Factory and Databricks ETL pipelines integrating multiple carrier and third-party logistics APIs into Azure Cosmos DB, enabling near-real-time shipment tracking and a unified view of logistics data. I also built and owned Power BI dashboards for logistics KPIs and shipment performance, contributing to a 20% reduction in delivery delays.

At Bosch Rexroth AG, I worked as a Business Intelligence Intern from March 2023 to August 2023. I developed an SCD-based master data model integrating Azure SQL and MongoDB, enabling historical tracking and accurate billing for more than 2,000 customers.

At Bosch Rexroth AG, I automated end-to-end invoice generation and reporting using Microsoft Power Platform, including Power Automate, Power Apps and Power BI, together with Python. This reduced errors by 60% and saved about 35 hours of manual work per month.

At Bosch Rexroth AG, I partnered with the Global Controlling team to enhance performance reporting, expanding high-level KPIs into more than 20 granular business metrics for deeper analysis and decision-making.

At Amazon, I worked as a Project Management Intern from July 2022 to December 2022. I designed and built AWS-based ETL pipelines using S3, Lambda and Redshift to automate EMEA food-safety audit data processing, centralizing more than 100,000 records for analytics and reporting.

At Amazon, I developed AWS QuickSight dashboards integrating audit and ticketing data, improving compliance KPI visibility for more than 100 EMEA stakeholders and contributing to a 20% reduction in audit findings.

At Amazon, I redesigned audit checklists with global auditors and subject-matter experts, standardizing compliance data collection across more than 30 EMEA sites to enable cross-site benchmarking and trend analysis.

At Divya Industries, I worked as a Production Engineer from April 2019 to October 2020. I led data-driven process optimization that improved manufacturing efficiency by 15% and reduced operating costs by 10%. I also integrated laser cladding into manufacturing processes, improving wear resistance and extending product life by 30%.
I completed an M.Sc. in Scientific Instrumentation at Ernst-Abbe-Hochschule Jena in Germany in 2025. I completed a B.Tech. in Mechanical Engineering at JNTU Hyderabad in India in 2019.
My programming skills include Python and SQL. My data-engineering skills include ETL and ELT, Apache Spark, Databricks, Azure Data Factory, dbt, Apache Airflow, and Apache Kafka.

My cloud and data-platform experience includes Microsoft Azure, AWS, Microsoft Fabric, Snowflake, Azure Synapse Analytics, and Delta Lake. My database experience includes PostgreSQL, MySQL, MongoDB, and Azure Cosmos DB.

My machine-learning and AI skills include Scikit-learn, TensorFlow, PyTorch, Generative AI, retrieval-augmented generation, and large language models. My business-intelligence tools include Power BI, Tableau, and AWS QuickSight.

My development and automation tools include FastAPI, Git, Docker, and Microsoft Power Platform, including Power Automate, Power Apps, and Power Pages. I speak English at C1 level and German at B2 level.
